name: @blake-r/dsh-loop-guard
description: DSH host plugins guarding agent loops: a reasoning-loop guard (aborts degenerate thinking blocks, reminds the model to make progress) and a repeat-pattern reminder (detects repeated tool calls and complex alternations). One package, two plugin rows sharing an internal coordination module.

scripts.check: node --check src/dsh-host-reasoning-loop-guard.mjs && node --check src/dsh-host-repeat-pattern-reminder.mjs && node --check src/dsh-loop-guard-shared.mjs
